sentences.text: Present:-
Mr. Pankaj Kumar Sharma, Advocate for the applicants.
Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, Aga for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

The applicants Smt. Sabri and Aakil seek anticipatory bail in FIR/Case Crime No.311 of 2024 dated
08.05.2024, under Sections 120-B, 420, 506 Ipc, Police Station Kotwali Roorkee, District Haridwar.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the informant had purchased the property from the applicant no.1.
But thereafter, the applicant no.2 and another co-accused instigated the applicant no.1 to file objections in the mutation proceeding, so that they may get more money.

4. Let State file objections within four weeks.
5.

6. Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicants shall be released on bail subject to their furnishing personal bond and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, by each one of them, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicants shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witnesses in the case.
(ii) They shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) They shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) They shall deposit their passports with the AO.
